models.title: Density histogram: assign records, then recover mass by area
models.invariant: The horizontal axis retains actual bin widths. Counts and density heights are different quantities. Bins are [left,right), with the last right endpoint included.
code: Start with zero counts.
Locate one record using both endpoint tests.
Increase only its bin count.
Divide each count by sample size and actual width.
Check that the areas sum to one.
